description: Elementwise Quality Focal Loss for continuous targets in [0, 1], following Generalized Focal Loss Section 3 Eq. (2); avg_factor divides the summed loss by N_pos as in Eq. (8). Trainer passes loss_kwargs to the loss callable in src/topologies/training/losses.py:198-200.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    targets = torch.rand(2, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "targets": synth.Tensor(targets)}
ds = synth.Spec("quality-focal-multilabel", generator=samples, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "quality-focal-loss", "loss_kwargs": {"beta": 2.0}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a multilabel model with Quality Focal Loss

name: Quality Focal Loss

parameters.additional parameters: beta and avg_factor only; unrecognized keyword parameters raise ValueError
parameters.avg_factor: optional finite positive scalar denominator for the summed loss; accepted only with mean reduction (default None)
parameters.beta: finite nonnegative probability-error focusing exponent (default 2.0; paper Section 3 Eq. (2))
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because continuous quality targets have no ignored-index convention
parameters.logits_or_prediction: nonempty finite floating-point logits tensor of any shape
parameters.reduction: none returns elementwise losses, mean averages all elements, or sum totals all elements (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point tensor on the same device and with the same shape as logits, with finite values in [0, 1]
